completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

completed_missions.title: Hixton 0.5.0 validated ten-core baseline
completed_missions.result: Protected ten-core product baseline reached exact-head A01-A11 with A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS. The owner then superseded the core-only/live-trial objective with the 10+up-to-5 satellite dynamic-capital architecture before broader Live activation.

active_mission.title: Hixton 10+5 shared-capital architecture
active_mission.objective: Starting from the protected ten-core V6 product, validate up to five complementary satellites, build a point-in-time HOLD/SWITCH/TRIM opportunity router, and evolve max_capital_usdc into the single user truth whose allocation is derived dynamically for 50/250/1000/5000/20000+ USDC.
constraints: The protected gpt/usdc-audit product remains unchanged until a candidate passes the full promotion chain.
Step 4 profiles are frozen; shared-portfolio outcomes may reject them but may not retune them.
Step 5 uses one real shared account budget C, reference 250 USDC, across ten Core plus the frozen Satellite pool.
Isolated 15xC means fifteen independent diagnostic accounts and must never be presented as aggregate account capital.
No Core label has unconditional priority; later HOLD/SWITCH/TRIM routing must use only point-in-time normalized opportunity value after costs/risk/time/uncertainty.
Trade count alone is not success. Final architecture must improve or preserve robust shared-account profit while reducing avoidable idle capital.
max_capital_usdc is the single eventual user capital input; slot count/tranches/reserve are derived, not separate user truths.
Same normalized router semantics must scale across 50/250/1000/5000/20000+ USDC without fixed absolute-USDC switch thresholds.
No private Binance credentials in cloud, no real/testnet cloud orders, no automatic Paper/Live activation.
A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS remain mandatory before engineering promotion.
acceptance: Step 5 proves which frozen Satellites add marginal baseline-and-stress shared-portfolio profit and reduce zero-position time.
Step 6 validates the selected Satellite set across cross-window, shifted-three-year, future-readiness and independent red-team gates.
Step 7 implements and validates point-in-time HOLD/SWITCH/TRIM without future leakage or unconditional Core preemption.
Step 8 proves scale invariance and dynamic allocation across representative account budgets.
Step 9 makes Backtest/UI/Paper/Trial/Live consume the same promoted 10+up-to-5 universe/router semantics.
Step 10 materializes a D14 engineering candidate and runs exact-head A01-A11.
Step 11 requires A09 QA_PASS, A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS and protected engineering promotion.
